note: Adapted from the original English description in Snyder 1922, where the species is described as Armitermes intermedius, new species; type locality Ceiba, Spanish Honduras, collected by W. M. Mann in February—March 1920 (months 2—3) in rotten wood; soldier holotype Cat. No. 24572, U.S.N.M.; also recorded from Lombardia. Now placed in Cahuallitermes. In the original soldier measurements the entry "abdomen plus thorax" is printed as 4.04.85 in the OCR, which from context should be 4.0—4.85.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Head much wider and shorter than in A. heterotypus Silvestri; the combination of broad head, short nasus and position of the marginal tooth is very distinctive: the marginal tooth lies near the middle of the mandible, its outer edge is close to the inner edge of the mandible and distinctly parallel to the mandibular margin, and its inner edge forms an acute angle with the mandible; the nasus is slightly shorter than the width of the head at its narrowest point (the anterior margin); the tip of the labrum is membranous and white, looking like a hollow white fleshy tube.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellowish brown, slightly darker on either side of the nasus; head longer than wide, in profile slightly flask-shaped, widest at the base, gradually narrowing forwards, the base rounded; a few long hairs or bristles on the anterior and posterior margins of the head. Postmentum long and slender, narrowing forwards, the lateral margins dark chestnut brown. Nasus widest at the base, narrowing towards the tip, the tip slightly concave; in profile the tip of the nasus lies directly above the tip of the labrum; the tip of the nasus bears short hairs. Mandibles dark chestnut brown to black, yellowish brown at the base, projecting beyond the tip of the nasus when closed; mandibles curved, broad at the base, slender at the tip. Labrum widest at the base, yellowish brown, narrowing towards the tip, covered with long golden-yellow hairs. Antennae yellowish brown, longer than the head, slender, 15—16-segmented, with long hairs; 1st segment long, stout, cylindrical; 2nd shorter, narrower, nearly clavate; 3rd clavate, slightly longer than the 2nd; 4th and 5th subequal, about equal to or slightly longer than the 3rd; 6th longer; from the 7th onwards gradually clavate and narrower; terminal segment nearly oval, slender. Posterior margin of the pronotum yellowish brown, saddle-shaped, widest in the middle, nearly twice as wide as long, the ends rounded, the posterior half trapezoidal, the lateral margins with long hairs. Abdomen grey with yellow, covered with long golden-yellow hairs. Legs pale yellow, long, slender. Measurements (mm): total length 5.75—7.25; head with mandibles 3.1—3.35; head without mandibles (to the clypeal margin) 2.15—2.30; left mandible length 1.25—1.35; head with nasus 2.75—2.95; nasus length 0.95—1.2; abdomen plus thorax together 4.0—4.85; pronotum length 0.50—0.60; hind tibia 1.80—2.00; head width (at the widest point) 1.90—2.15; pronotum width 1.15—1.20.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head yellow-white, with longitudinal grey markings, not much longer than wide, widest anteriorly, rounded behind; postclypeus swollen, twice as wide as long. Antennae yellowish brown apically, 15-segmented; 1st segment long, stout, cylindrical; 2nd shorter and narrower; 3rd slightly longer than the 2nd. Pronotum saddle-shaped, pale yellow. Abdomen grey. Legs pale yellow, long, slender. Measurements (mm): total length 5.0—5.75; abdomen plus thorax together 3.80—4.10; head length 1.65—1.75; hind tibia 1.25—1.80; head width 1.40—1.50.
